public_page_goal: Interactive Markdown lecture notes for MAE598/494 Design Optimization: second-order and quasi-Newton methods including steepest descent, Newton, CG, trust region, BFGS, and L-BFGS.
slide_outline: Steepest descent under general norms and preconditioning.
Newton's method: quadratic convergence, globalization with Armijo, modified Cholesky.
Conjugate gradient for symmetric positive definite quadratic objectives.
Trust-region methods: Cauchy point, dogleg, CG-Steihaug subsolvers.
BFGS: positive definite inverse Hessian update from gradient history.
L-BFGS: limited-memory two-loop recursion for large-scale problems.
Summary comparison of GD, CG, Newton, trust region, BFGS, L-BFGS.
Exercises on exact line search, CG conjugacy, Newton convergence, and BFGS positive definiteness.
